The City of Lawrence invites Douglas County residents to recycle
electronic equipment in a way that is safe and sustainable!
SATURDAY, AUGUST 8, 2026
DOUGLAS COUNTY FAIRGROUNDS
9 AM - 1 PM
2120 HARPER STREET, LAWRENCE
Items accepted for recycling:
COMPUTERS, LAPTOPS, MONITORS,
SPEAKERS, KEYBOARDS, MICE, SERVERS,
MICROWAVES, TVS, GAMING SYSTEMS,
LIGHT FIXTURES (NO LIGHT BULBS),
NON-PCB BALLASTS, STEREOS, RADIOS,
PHONES, AUDIO / VISUAL EQUIPMENT,
LAB EQUIPMENT, CABLES, BATTERY
BACKUP SYSTEMS, SMALL APPLIANCES
Fees for Select
Items ONLY:
Items NOT accepted:
CRT TVs & Monitors - $40
Projection TVs - $40 VHS TAPES, CDS, DVDS, FIRE ALARMS,
LCD TVs & Monitors - $10 SMOKE DETECTORS, THERMOMETERS,
LIGHT BULBS, PCB BALLASTS, CHEMICALS,
(**Cash, Paypal, & Venmo ONLY)
HOUSEHOLD BATTERIES, TIRES,
FURNITURE, LARGE APPLIANCES,
DEVICES CONTAINING FREON, SUCH AS
REFRIGERATORS AND DEHUMIDIFIERS
All Other Items FREE!

For More Information,
scan the QR code or visit
lawrenceks.gov/mso/electronics-recycling
